summary.headline: CORESTEMCHEMON signs KRW 2.27bn supply contract for 2026 chemical hazard test data production
summary.what_happened: On Nov 23, 2026, CORESTEMCHEMON Inc. signed a single supply contract for the production of 2026 chemical substance hazard test data (environmental energy research and survey services) with Incheon Regional Public Procurement Service, with the Korea Environment Corporation as the end-user agency. The contract period runs from Nov 23, 2026 to Nov 18, 2027, and the end date is the delivery deadline. The contract is not conditional, and it is produced in-house.

key_numbers.label: Contract amount as % of recent revenue
Advance payment
key_numbers.value: 30% of contract amount, paid within 5 days of tax invoice issuance

summary.why_it_matters: Single supply contract disclosures in Korea are filed when a company wins a contract above a set size threshold, so shareholders can track the company's order flow and revenue visibility. Contract amounts and timing are often subject to change as projects progress, so the figures disclosed at signing may not reflect final results.
